card.text: Small inner moon of Uranus, named for Kate's sister in The Taming of the Shrew.

introduction.text: Bianca orbits about 59,165 km from Uranus. Little is known about it beyond its size and orbit.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 64 × 46 × 46 km shape estimate, with two axes assumed equal; there are no surface images.
